audit.why: Lillia's E carries a derived 'terrain' flag, but Riot's Swirlseed text only says the seed rolls until it hits a wall or a target. Treated as a tooltip-parsing misfire, matching the mirror; nothing written claiming Swirlseed can wall off Shadow Dash, and the existing 'Swirlseed over the wall to deny your E' claim was removed.

edits.before: With Q move-speed and W DOT both online at level 3 she can poke you below 60% HP without entering Spirit's Refuge range — she controls the spacing and wins the attrition.
edits.after: Blooming Blows (Q) does true damage on its outer edge, so armour does nothing — at level 3 she spaces outside Spirit's Refuge range and wins the attrition.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are her clearest window: full poke kit, no meaningful ability you have scales faster than her kite speed, and she can Swirlseed over the wall to deny your E.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are her clearest window: Swirlseed (E) is a 12s slow that rolls until it hits you or a wall, and nothing you have outruns her stacked Q move speed.
